prompt:
TASK CONTEXT — MM6 FANTASY-GAME ASSET RESTORATION: faithful high-definition reconstruction of the skeleton painted in the EXISTING Might and Magic VI cage decoration sprites, as a 3D modelling and texturing reference. Not a new design.
Use case: stylized-concept / faithful 3D modelling reference.
Output: exactly ONE 1024 x 1536 PORTRAIT PNG, genuine transparent background, unresized native return.

Input 1: ORIGINAL native MM6 hngncge2 hanging-cage sprite enlarged 3x nearest neighbour. Skeleton anatomy, lean average adult proportions and warm bone-colour authority. Black cage bars are NOT skeleton anatomy. Magenta is background.
Input 2: ORIGINAL native MM6 bonecage seated-skeleton sprite enlarged 3x nearest neighbour; second skeleton anatomy reference. Cage bars are NOT part of the skeleton. Magenta is background.
Input 3: restored 2x hngncge2, BONE SURFACE MATERIAL ONLY. Ignore the cage, pose, black bars and edge artifacts.

ONE complete adult human skeleton, whole body head to toes, centred, generous margins, near-orthographic camera, transparent background, no stand, no floor, no shadow, no text, no cage. Even soft neutral studio light (no dramatic light) that still shows form. Credible anatomical sculpt, semi-realistic game material, sharp fine detail.

Identity: anatomically correct adult human skeleton, lean, average proportions (head about one eighth of the height): skull with the lower jaw attached, mouth closed; cervical spine; collarbones and shoulder blades; a full rib cage of twelve rib pairs with clear open gaps between the ribs and a sternum; lumbar spine; a bowl-shaped pelvis; humerus, radius and ulna as separate bones; hands with exactly five clearly separate articulated bony digits each, including the thumb; femur, kneecap, tibia and fibula; feet with separate toe bones. Colour from inputs 1 and 3: aged dry bone, warm honey-tan to pale cream on the highlights, darker ochre-brown in the joints, between the ribs and in the sockets; eye sockets near black. Matte, no flesh, no sinew, no blood. Do not fill rib gaps with solid material; empty spaces between bones remain transparent.

Pose (identical in all five views): standing upright in a clean neutral A-pose: arms straight, about 35 degrees away from the sides, palms facing forward, fingers slightly spread and clearly separated; legs straight with a clear gap between them, feet flat, toes forward; head level, looking straight ahead. No bone touches another limb. Do not copy either source sprite's hanging or huddled pose. This skeleton will later be rigged and re-posed for the cages.

Input 4: SELECTED PRIMARY high-definition front-right three-quarter skeleton. This is the strict identity, exact fixed A-POSE, bone lengths, skull-to-height ratio, rib-cage proportions, pelvis shape and surface-material authority for this camera rotation. Render the SAME skeleton, not a new interpretation. Keep its arms straight and anatomically abducted about 35 degrees from the torso, palms toward the body's forward direction, five separated articulated digits on each hand, head level, legs straight and a little apart, feet flat and pointing forward. Rotate only the camera around the unchanged skeleton. Do not re-pose or mirror the skeleton.

Output ONE unresized native 1024 x 1536 PORTRAIT PNG, genuine transparent alpha. Complete skeleton from crown to all toes and all fingertips, centred at the same useful scale as the primary, generous transparent margins, no cropping. Warm honey-tan aged dry bone with pale cream highlights, darker ochre-brown joints and near-black eye sockets. Even soft neutral object-only studio illumination. Keep all inter-bone gaps open and transparent; no opaque fill in rib cage.
Do NOT add a cage, stand, floor, cast shadow, backdrop, haze, glow, text, armour, cloth, rope, chains, weapon, horns, extra ribs/limbs, flesh, sinew or blood. No cartoon, oversized skull, white/grey bone, painted checkerboard, magenta spill or background gradient.
Checks: whole body, open twelve-pair rib cage, separate forearm bones, five separate digits per visible hand, straight arms clear of torso, legs apart, warm tan bone, genuine transparency, SAME pose and proportions as primary.
Input 5: selected FRONT reference of the SAME skeleton, confirming the fixed straight-arm approximately 35-degree A-pose. Use the identical pose in body space.

CAMERA FOR 04_RIGHT: exact RIGHT SIDE / lateral profile of the skeleton's OWN ANATOMICAL RIGHT. Orbit the camera 90 degrees around to the body's RIGHT from front. The RIGHT cheek/temple, RIGHT shoulder, RIGHT forearm and RIGHT hip are the near side. The nose, sternum-facing direction and toes point toward SCREEN-RIGHT. View the whole body from this true lateral camera, near-orthographic at chest height, only slightly above; no frontal or three-quarter torso and no head twist.
The SAME upright neutral A-pose remains unchanged in body space: both straight arms abducted laterally approximately 35 degrees, palms facing the body's forward direction (SCREEN-RIGHT), straight separated legs, toes forward. The lateral camera naturally foreshortens the lateral arm/leg separation, so far limbs may overlap behind the near limbs in projection. Keep physically correct occlusion; DO NOT swing an arm forward/back, spread legs in depth, bend elbows, turn hands or otherwise re-pose to display both sides. Keep all bones physically separated even where projected silhouettes overlap. Include the complete visible five-digit near hand, separate radius/ulna where visible, and full head-to-toes and both feet inside the frame. Preserve primary bone lengths, head-about-one-eighth ratio, pelvis and warm tan dry bone material.
ONE 1024 x 1536 PORTRAIT transparent PNG, native return unresized. Center the entire lateral skeleton with generous empty margins top/bottom and sides; full skull and all fingertips/toes without clipping. Correct anatomical right view of the SAME skeleton, not simply a flipped image of a left view. No cage, text, floor, stand, shadow or background.
